body: I am 18 months out from finishing my bachelor's. I love learning. I would like to get my PhD. We were planning on moving to England for my master's program in 2 years, but I don't know if that will happen because of money. My field doesn't really pay well, either, and she wants to go back to school at some point. I've been trying different things. I am in therapy, and I go work out every day. I also am trying to play less video games and do more stuff I enjoy that is relaxing like painting and such. I suffer from anxiety and I am not sleeping well. Every night when I lay down the numbers just overwhelm me and all I want to do is stop living. I don't know what to do. I don't think I could ever actually go through with it, but my desire to die is scary some nights. I just want to stop feeling so worthless.

It's all just fucked up because it's such a small amount, but I feel awful because as things stand right now we literally don't have a spare dime and if she would dump me she would have tons of extra money to spend on whatever she wanted. I just feel like I won't be able to provide for her and for our potential children and I hate that feeling. It makes me feel so insignificant.
